name: bridgebox-collector
description: BridgeBox desktop activity collector (metadata only: foreground app + coarse document category; never keystrokes, clipboard, screenshots, URLs or titles).

scripts.package:win: echo 'npm i -g @yao-pkg/pkg && pkg dist/collector/src/index.js --targets node20-win-x64 --output release/bridgebox-collector.exe' && pkg dist/collector/src/index.js --targets node20-win-x64 --output release/bridgebox-collector.exe
scripts.package:mac: echo 'npm i -g @yao-pkg/pkg && pkg dist/collector/src/index.js --targets node20-macos-arm64,node20-macos-x64 --output release/bridgebox-collector' && pkg dist/collector/src/index.js --targets node20-macos-arm64,node20-macos-x64 --output release/bridgebox-collector
